what: Every driver's best valid qualifying lap at the five sim circuits of the 2026 season (silverstone, monza, monaco, spa, hungaroring) and his gap to the teammate of that weekend. Real data, nothing simulated.
sources: OpenF1 (api.openf1.org/v1) via concept/data/telemetry/<circuit>/<circuit>-2026-q-index.json and the lap files (best valid lap: lap times deleted by race control and pit-out laps excluded); each folder's README cross-checks all 22 times against the formula1.com classification
Silverstone lap times: js/data/racepace2026.js (official); PER's telemetry file differs by 0.489 s (audit C1), the official time is used
Audit status per lap: concept/data/telemetry/audit/telemetry_audit.csv (a FAIL concerns a telemetry channel, never the lap time here)
attribution: Telemetry from OpenF1 (openf1.org), an independent community project not associated with Formula 1, the FIA or FOM; timing data belongs to Formula 1. Non-commercial research use.

our_driver.definition: Owner decision: the season's 'our driver' is the Red Bull driver the RB22 is calibrated on (HAD, whose 2026 British GP lap the Red Bull car was fitted to; at every circuit the Red Bull car's set-up is fitted to that driver's lap). At Monza OpenF1 has LAW in the Red Bull and no HAD, so LAW stands in there. Default: NO driver-gap adjustment, i.e. our lap = the sim lap of our RB22 (concept/sim simulateLap of the design's car with the Red Bull set-up at that circuit).
our_driver.optional_adjustment: 'Our car driven like driver X' at circuit C = sim lap of our RB22 at C + (X's real best lap at C - our driver's real best lap at C), i.e. circuits[C].drivers[X].lap_s - circuits[C].redbull.our_lap_s. For X = VER that is circuits[C].redbull.VER_minus_our_s (negative = VER was faster). It folds car differences in when X drove another car; use it only for Red Bull drivers (VER, HAD, LAW) or as a what-if.

PER.note: official 91.451 s used; the telemetry file's lap reads 91.94 s (audit C1)

redbull.note: OpenF1 (and the formula1.com classification) list LAW at Red Bull Racing and TSU at Racing Bulls for this session, no HAD: LAW is the Red Bull driver the RB22 stands for here
